title: Design: the PDF-too-large message matches the design picture
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has more than 2,000 open A/P lines on today's date.
    For example: the QA organization (13,540 open A/P lines).
  • Starting screen: A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu in light theme at 100% zoom, with every bucket collapsed.
  • The design picture "PDF over 2,000 rows is refused" (ar-ap-p2-pdf-over-2-000-rows-is-refused.png) is attached to this case and open beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  2. Compare the message with the picture.
  3. Read the message, letter for letter.
  4. Click "Close" on the message.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: one message appears at the bottom right of the window and nothing downloads.
  • Step 2: a solid red box with a white warning triangle at the left, white text, and a white "Close" at the right, with no title line, as in the picture; the report behind it does not change.
  • Step 3: "This report is too large for PDF. Export it as CSV, or narrow the filters, then try again."
  • Step 4: the message closes.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • S3-N1: “Over 2,000 rows, the PDF is refused before anything is generated: no download, and the message "This report is too large for PDF. Export it as CSV, or narrow the filters, then try again." Exactly 2,000 rows is allowed.”
  • S3-N3: “A refused export shows exactly one message (S3-N1 or S3-N2), never a second generic error.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “PDF export over 2,000 rows | "This report is too large for PDF. Export it as CSV, or narrow the filters, then try again." | Error toast, as on the other reports; nothing downloads”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 2 "Export" (board Export.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p2-pdf-over-2-000-rows-is-refused.png: figure "PDF over 2,000 rows is refused" (This build (after)), board "2. Export"

The design's own words:

  • ""This report is too large for PDF. Export it as CSV, or narrow the filters, then try again." Exactly one message. CSV limit 50,000 rows. S3-N1, S3-N2, S3-N3." (caption of "PDF over 2,000 rows is refused")
